question: Which classes of semi-divine beings are further included in this encompassing vision?
premises: Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas are named
They are included in the same vision
inference: The vision also includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas are included, O beloved.
